content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

This infrastructure is aimed at digital creators who want to sell their beats without relying on conventional payment processors that often impose high fees or are unavailable in certain regions. By using crypto payments, creators can retain more of their earnings and ensure direct access to their funds. The importance of this model cannot be overstated—it allows individuals to operate independently, maintain ownership of their products, and navigate financial systems that often exclude them.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture is built using a combination of free tools and services. For hosting, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are utilized, providing a reliable platform for your digital store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, enabling automated delivery of your beats upon purchase. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the payment in over 300 cryptocurrencies, significantly reducing transaction costs compared to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This seamless integration ensures you receive payments quickly and can deliver your products without delay.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators—musicians, producers, and anyone selling digital products—who face limitations with mainstream payment systems. If you are situated in regions where financial services are restricted or have experienced payment rejection, this infrastructure empowers you to sell your work directly to your audience. It eliminates dependence on third-party platforms, allowing you to build a sustainable income stream without worrying about excessive fees or account freezes.
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale; NOWPayments only charges 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The essential components include hosting services, backend processing tools, a payment gateway, and a delivery mechanism. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide the front end, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage logic and delivery. NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you keep more of your profits. Together, these components create a robust system that enables you to operate independently and efficiently, providing a complete solution for selling beats and other digital products online.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To set up your digital store, start by selecting your preferred hosting service, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for payment processing, ensuring you enable crypto options that suit your audience. Finally, load your beats into the system and test the entire setup to guarantee smooth operation before launching it to your customers. You can find all necessary resources in the Complete Builder Kit ($197), available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can leverage a sovereign commerce infrastructure that utilizes crypto payments. By deploying a stack built with tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you can create a fully operational store where you retain full data ownership and enjoy lower transaction fees compared to traditional platforms. This way, you maintain control and ensure your earnings are maximized.
At 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain $921 more with our infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're exploring how to sell digital downloads with crypto payments, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It provides all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build your sovereign digital commerce stack. This is the comprehensive solution for creators looking to operate independently of traditional payment systems and maximize their profits.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Yes, by utilizing a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for accepting crypto, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your audience without relying on third-party platforms.
What are the advantages of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges only a 0.5% fee on transactions, significantly lower than many alternatives. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allows for instant payment confirmations, and requires no KYC, streamlining the process for both sellers and buyers.
How do I ensure automated delivery of my products?

You can automate the delivery of your products by using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle the backend logic of your store. This allows for instant delivery of your digital products as soon as a payment is confirmed.
